title: User profile contract
description: Language-neutral user profile shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. userProfile and userPrivate mirror the target Firestore collections documented in docs/firebase-data-model.md (documents keyed by Firebase UID). Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

userProfile.description: Public user profile — Firestore `users/{uid}`. Any authenticated user can read; owner can update non-protected fields; backend (Admin SDK) manages protected fields (role, activeMember, suspended, deleted).

onboardingCompletedAt.description: Written by auth.completeOnboarding with a server timestamp — backend-managed only; null until onboarding is complete.

userPrivate.description: Sensitive user data — Firestore `userPrivate/{uid}`. Owner-only read and write; no other users may access this collection. Email is a contact channel, not an identity key.

notificationPreferences.description: Push/email preferences map. Intentionally left open-ended until the notifications domain contracts land (PR 2b) — the key/value shape is not yet contracted and must not be relied on for native codegen.

ageConfirmedAt.description: Consent audit record written by auth.completeOnboarding — backend-managed only; clients cannot write it (Security Rules).

termsAcceptedAt.description: Consent audit record written by auth.completeOnboarding — backend-managed only; clients cannot write it (Security Rules).

privacyPolicyAcceptedAt.description: Consent audit record written by auth.completeOnboarding — backend-managed only; clients cannot write it (Security Rules).

anonymousPartnerStatsOptIn.description: Privacy setting for anonymised partner statistics. Defaults to false (explicit opt-in); owner-editable.

userSummary.description: Admin-facing user summary as exposed by backend list endpoints (mirrors packages/shared/src/users.ts UserSummary).
